attchmntText: CMS Info Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "The Company hereby informs the exchange regarding press release dated November 13, 2026, on Un-Audited (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, titled "CMS Info Systems reports fourth consecutive quarter of record services revenue at Rs. 644 Cr. Q2FY27, up 16.2% YoY"".
voiceSummary: CMS Info Systems Limited filed an intimation regarding its media release for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated total revenue of Rs. 650 Cr, up 6.7% year-on-year. Services revenue reached Rs. 644 Cr, a 16.2% increase year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 173 Cr, up 24.8% year-on-year, with an EBITDA margin of 26.7%. Profit after tax was Rs. 81 Cr, up 10.3% year-on-year. Diluted earnings per share were Rs. 5.05. Cash Logistics segment revenue was Rs. 404 Cr, while Managed Services and Technology Solutions revenue was Rs. 321 Cr. The earnings conference call is scheduled for November 14, 2026, at 2.00 pm IST.

attchmntText: CMS Info Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: CMS Info Systems Limited filed a presentation for its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call scheduled for November 14, 2026. Services revenue reached 644 Cr, up 16.2% year-on-year. EBITDA was 173 Cr with a margin of 26.7%. H1 operating cash flow improved to 177 Cr from an outflow of 117 Cr in H1 FY26. Tech and Payments revenue annualized at 508 Cr, representing 20% of services revenue. The company reported H1 order wins of 700 Cr. Repricing is largely complete for private sector banks, while negotiations with public sector banks are underway. FY27 capex is projected at 100 to 125 Cr. Total revenue for Q2 was 650 Cr, up 6.7% year-on-year. Profit after tax was 81 Cr.

attchmntText: Intimation for participation of Company in Investor Conference Titled "India Xchange 2026" organized by JM Financial Limited scheduled to be held on Tuesday, November 17, 2026.
voiceSummary: CMS Info Systems Limited has intimated that its authorized officials, including Ankeet Bhat and Sumit Pradhan, will participate in the India Xchange 2026 investor conference organized by JM Financial Limited. The event is scheduled for Tuesday, November 17, 2026, from 10:00 A.M. to 12:00 Noon at Hotel Trident, BKC Mumbai. The meeting will be conducted in person. Discussions will be based on publicly available information, and no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies.

attchmntText: Intimation of Earnings Conference Call scheduled to be held on Saturday, November 14, 2026, at 02:00 P.M. (IST) to discuss Q2FY27 earnings
voiceSummary: CMS Info Systems Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call for Saturday, November 14, 2026, at 02:00 P.M. IST to discuss Q2FY27 earnings. The management team, including Executive Vice Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Rajiv Kaul, Chief Financial Officer Pankaj Khandelwal, Chief Business Officer Anush Raghavan, and Chief Operating Officer Puneet Bhirani, will participate. The event is organized by Elara Securities. Dial-in numbers and registration details are provided in the accompanying invitation. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
